about: How many slides a carousel may have on each platform, and the image ratio the skill renders for it. One entry for each platform key of accounts.json. An entry with a max takes carousels; one without takes none (an X, YouTube, YouTube Shorts or MakerWorld account is skipped). The slide count of a carousel runs from the largest min to the smallest max among the accounts it is owed to. min is this skill's floor of 2 where a platform states none. ratios[0] is the ratio the skill renders; sizes says what that ratio is in pixels and where the files go.

instagram.source: Instagram Help Center, "Share a post with multiple photos or videos on Instagram" and "Image resolution of photos you share on Instagram"; Meta, Instagram Platform content publishing.
instagram.notes: Up to 20 photos and videos in one post. Every slide is cropped to one ratio; 4:5 is inside the app's range and is the shared master size. The API takes JPEG only.

tiktok.source: TikTok for Developers, Content Posting API photo post reference.
tiktok.notes: Up to 35. No ratio or file limit is stated for photos; the skill uses 9:16 at 1080x1920.

facebook.source: Facebook Help, "How to share photos"; Meta, Pages API "Posts". Neither publishes a maximum.
facebook.notes: Facebook states no maximum and no ratio. 10 is an assumption: confirm it on the first real post.

threads.notes: 2 to 20. JPEG or PNG, 8 MB each, ratio at most 10:1, sRGB, at least 320 px wide.

linkedin.source: Microsoft Learn, LinkedIn Marketing API, MultiImage; LinkedIn Help, "Upload and share documents on LinkedIn".
linkedin.notes: 2 to 20 images, JPG, PNG or GIF under 36,152,320 pixels each, no ratio limit stated. A document post (one PDF) is the other route.

pinterest.notes: 2 to 5. 1:1 or 2:3 only, static images, made on desktop only; the skill uses 2:3 at 1000x1500.

x.source: X Developer docs, media best practices.
x.notes: Takes no carousel here: up to 4 photos shown as a grid. JPG, PNG, GIF or WEBP, 5 MB each.

youtube.notes: Takes no carousel here: an image post of up to 10 images made from the channel's Posts tab, not a video upload.

youtube shorts.source: YouTube Help: searched, no image post type found.

makerworld.source: The Content Board app's own preset.
makerworld.notes: Takes no carousel: a listing account (accepts: listing).
